claims.text: Transcript tokens grow as O(V^2 R^2): four vendors x three rounds is twelve calls each carrying up to eleven prior turns.

claims.text: Rotated between rounds so the role/vendor confound is at least stirred.
claims.why: No rotation logic is present in this chunk; the comment describes intended behavior not implemented here.

claims.text: Why the council stopped. Recorded, never inferred from a short transcript.

claims.text: vendors.py transport reasons -> bus.UNAVAILABLE_REASONS (a fixed, filterable vocabulary; the bus refuses anything outside it).
claims.why: The bus module is not in this chunk; _REASON_MAP is defined but its usage and the bus's refusal behavior are not shown.

observations.what: The docstring at the top of the chunk is a multi-line comment about testing and live-wire gate, but it is not a proper docstring for any symbol; it appears to be a leftover or explanatory note.
Imports include count_tokens from ..structcore.tokens, but count_tokens is not used in this chunk.
Several imports from .bus (append_roster, append_round, etc.) are imported but not used in this chunk.
The constant _SHIPPED_TRANSPORTS uses getattr on _vendors for 'run_managed' and 'native_chat'; if these are not defined, the tuple may be empty.
The _REASON_MAP only maps 'not_on_path', 'not_authenticated', 'connect_failed' but the chunk ends mid-definition; the mapping is incomplete.
